banner.title: TABLE 53 (INDIVIDUAL PIECE ARMOR CLASS), printed capture p. 95 - the OA piece armor round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the page - the nine-row grid cross-checked cell-by-cell between the two passes; the steps agree (2 for do-maru, hara-ate and haramaki-do, 1 elsewhere), the star set agrees (the hara-ate and hara-ate-gawa pair), and the backside footnote text agrees verbatim - zero contested cells. The definitional sentence under the table pins the steps semantics: the amount of improvement from AC 10 the piece provides; the page worked examples cross-check the arithmetic (kote alone AC 9; kote, do-maru and haidate AC 6). The backside star note pins as a bool (the starred pieces do not cover the backside at all - attacks from behind are treated as against armor class 10). The piece names are textual and ride the column comment per the T48 doctrine (the hyphenated spellings as printed). The one-piece-per-area rule, the pieces-not-with-suits rule and the o-yoroi full-suit note stay in the open armor prose box; Table 54 (capture p. 95) is deliberately left for the next round
